global: This miso ramen bowl features a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, a halved soft-boiled egg, and a dark nori sheet resting on the edge. The white ceramic bowl sits on a warm wooden surface, softly lit to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with smooth, slightly reflective surface and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and rounded rim, showing subtle interior stains.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, textured surface, golden-brown hue, swirling strands immersed in savory liquid.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows creamy white albumen surrounding a runny, orange-yellow yolk with a glossy, slightly uneven surface.
regions.seaweed: Dark, matte nori seaweed with irregular, slightly curled edges and a rough, porous surface.
